strings: AI Logo Maker Agent: Create Custom Vector Logos & Brand Kits

Get started
Professional Branding Tools
Perfect Typography
Powered by advanced models like Seedream and Ideogram, Lovart generates logos with correct, legible spelling and professional kerning—no more AI gibberish.
Vector Export (SVG)
The holy grail of logo design. Export your creations as infinite-resolution vectors, essential for billboards, clothing printing, and professional use.
Edit Elements
Deconstruct your logo. Lovart can separate the icon from the text, allowing you to move, resize, or recolor specific parts without destroying the whole image.
Instant Mockups
See your brand in the real world. One-click apply your logo to 3D rendered cups, signs, and apparel with realistic lighting and texture adaptation.
Transparent Backgrounds
Get a clean PNG instantly. Our precise background remover isolates your logo so you can layer it onto websites, videos, or presentations immediately.
Brand Consistency
Lovart remembers. Once your logo is defined, the agent can use it to generate matching social media posts, letterheads, and ads that stay strictly on-brand.
Not Just a Logo Maker. Your AI Brand Design Agent.

Stop settling for generic templates. Lovart's AI Agent understands your brand's DNA to create unique, professional logos. Generate infinite concepts, refine with precision text editing, and export production-ready vectors (SVG)—all on one intelligent canvas.

Generate Brand Logos
From Concept to Brand Kit in 3 Steps
Brief Your Agent
Describe your business, mission, and style. Our MCoT (Mind Chain of Thought) engine reasons like a creative director to propose concepts that fit your market positioning.
Refine & Vectorize
Select your favorite concept. Use 'Edit Text' to perfect the typography and convert your final design into a scalable SVG vector format ready for print and web.
Visualize Everywhere
Don't just imagine it. Use 'Mockup' to instantly see your new logo on business cards, storefronts, and merchandise directly on the ChatCanvas.

Freelance Designer
Can I trademark the logo I create?

Yes, you own the commercial rights to the designs you create on Lovart's paid plans. However, trademark laws vary by country regarding AI-generated content, so we recommend consulting a legal expert for IP registration.
What file formats can I download?
You can download your logos in high-resolution PNG, JPG, and most importantly, SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics), ensuring your logo looks crisp at any size.
Can I edit the text in the logo after generating?
Absolutely. Use the 'Edit Text' feature to fix typos, change the company name, or swap fonts while maintaining the logo's original style and layout.
Is this suitable for print?
Yes. With 4K upscaling and SVG vector export, Lovart generates files that are ready for professional printing on business cards, billboards, and merchandise.
How is this different from Canva?
Canva uses templates that thousands of others use. Lovart generates unique, original designs from scratch based on your specific prompt, ensuring your brand identity is one-of-a-kind.
